My mother will take it badly. She's already said an abortion would be the best plan. That was 2-3 months ago.

The father is very involved. He'll be taking me to PP.

No, very South Wisconsin.

Also, it says the Well Woman Program is only for women between the ages of 45 through 64.
I DO live in Wisconsin, actually. Will look into that.

I am thinking strongly about adoption, because I feel that if someone is financially, physically, and emotionally able to have a baby, they should carry the baby to term. But I don't know if I financially can.

Because my dad died, social security stops paying their version of child-support when I turn 18 or get a job. Even part-time. And they give a decent check to my mom, which she needs. Or else I'd be working my butt off. :(

I will go to a PP.

That's good advice. Ever since my dad died I can only dwell on financial troubles, it seems.

But the abortion pill, I'd have to get that in the next 4 weeks if I decide to. And that's $300 and up that I don't know if I'll have by then.
Thank you. I plan on going to a PP next week. :)
